# Sirach Chapter 23 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 23 | **Date:** 2026-03-17

---

**23:1** O LORD, Father and Master of my life, do not abandon me to their counsel; do not let me fall because of them.

**23:2** Who will set stripes over my thoughts, and the discipline of wisdom over my heart, so that they spare me not in my ignorances and do not overlook my sins?

**23:3** Lest my ignorances multiply and my sins abound, and I fall before the eyes of my adversaries, and my enemy rejoice over me.

**23:4** O LORD, Father and God of my life, do not give me an arrogant look, and divert desire away from me.

**23:5** Let not desire for the belly and for sexual intercourse take hold of me, and do not give me over to a shameless soul.

**23:6** Give ear, children, to the discipline of the mouth; and whoever keeps it will not be caught.

**23:7** In his sins the sinner is entrapped; and the proud man and the blasphemer stumble in them.

**23:8** Do not accustom your mouth to swearing oaths, and do not make it a habit to name the Holy One.

**23:9** For as a slave who is continually cross-examined will not lack for bruises, so also one who always swears and invokes the Name will never be free from sin.

**23:10** A man who swears much will be filled with iniquity, and the scourge will not depart from his house. If he offends, his sin is on him; if he disregards it, he has sinned doubly; if he swore in vain, he will not be acquitted, for his house will be filled with calamities.

**23:11** There is a mode of speech clothed about with death; may it not be found in the inheritance of Jacob. For all these things will be kept far from the godly, and they will not wallow in sins.

**23:12** Do not accustom your mouth to coarse language, for in it there is sinful speech.

**23:13** Remember your father and your mother, for you sit in the midst of great persons; and lest you forget yourself before them and through force of habit behave like a fool, and wish you had never been born, and curse the day of your birth.

**23:14** A man who is accustomed to abusive language will not be disciplined all his days.

**23:15** Two kinds of people multiply sins, and a third brings on wrath: a soul burning like fire will not be quenched until it has consumed; a man of fornication in the body of his flesh will not cease until fire burns out.

**23:16** All bread is sweet to the fornicator; he will not tire of it until death.

**23:17** A man who strays from his own bed says in his heart, "Who sees me? Darkness surrounds me, the walls cover me, and no one sees me. Of what do I need to be afraid? The Most High will not call my sins to mind."

**23:18** His eyes are on human eyes, yet he does not reflect that the eyes of the LORD are ten thousand times brighter than the sun, observing all the ways of men and penetrating into secret places.

**23:19** All things were known before they were created, and likewise after their completion.

**23:20** This man will be punished in the streets of the city; and where he did not expect it, he will be seized.

**23:21** So too the woman who abandoned her husband and provided an heir by a stranger.

**23:22** For first she was disobedient to the law of the Most High; and secondly she sinned against her husband; and thirdly she committed adultery in fornication and provided children by another man.

**23:23** She herself will be brought before the assembly, and her children will be subject to reckoning.

**23:24** Her children will not take root, and her branches will bear no fruit.

**23:25** She will leave her memory as a curse, and her disgrace will not be blotted out.

**23:26** And those who remain will know that there is nothing better than the fear of the LORD, and nothing sweeter than to attend to the commandments of the LORD.

**23:27** It is a great glory to follow the LORD; and length of days will be received from him.

**23:28** Whoever does these things will inherit glory, for the fear of the LORD leads to life and sets one to rest without disturbance at night.
